_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every price SciTeX publishes. Operator decision 2026-08-01: 「SSOT にしましょう」 / 「価格はjson あたりにしておくと使いやすいかと」. Before this file, /services/ hard-coded 9 JPY rows in its template and /landing/ hard-coded 12 USD items in its view; the two disagreed by up to 2.7x on the same service. Change a number HERE and it reaches every page and the brochure PDF together. A literal price anywhere else is a bug — tests/scitex_hub/public_app/test_pricing_ssot.py enforces it.
_amount_is_the_only_truth: Store the NUMBER, never a formatted string. Rendering derives '無料' from amount 0, the '〜' suffix from from_price, and the '月額' prefix from unit. Storing both 11000 and '11,000円' would be two representations of one fact, which is the duplication this file exists to remove.
tax_note: 表示価格はすべて税込(総額)です。

_subscription_status.note:
PRICES ARE PUBLISHED; BILLING IS NOT OPEN. Operator decision 2026-08-28. Three places must agree and this key is the contract between them:
  (1) plans[].subscription here — Individual 2,980 / Lab 100,000, monthly, tax-included
  (2) BILLING_PLANS (settings_commerce.py) stays [] — so /pricing/ lists no checkout button and billing_checkout refuses; the payment path is shut at TWO points (operator-only, and it aborts without a Stripe key)
  (3) /特商法/ states the prices AND that card payment begins after Stripe's corporate review — so the page never simultaneously denies and advertises paid plans
The previous state was not_offered, whose contract was the mirror image: 'no paid plans exist, keep all three saying so'. Do not move ONE of the three without the other two; that inconsistency is exactly what this key exists to prevent.
_subscription_status.lab_price_is_a_list_price_on_purpose: 100,000/month replaced 49,800〜 on 2026-08-28. The operator's reasoning: publish high and come down via coupons and individual quotes, because being wrong downward is safer than being wrong upward. Hence a flat figure with no 〜 — a range invites negotiation from the bottom of it.

_pending_operator_decision.note: Two items removed from /landing/ are COMMITMENTS, not indicative bands, and are parked here rather than deleted so they are not lost: a reader could have relied on either. Restore or retire them explicitly.

_subscription_is_not_a_consulting_band: plans[].price_ref points into `consulting` and is a PROJECT band (one-off or retainer engagements, anchored to real 2024 invoices). plans[].subscription is the SaaS monthly price. They are different products that happen to sit on the same card, so they are separate fields rather than one overloaded number. Enterprise carries NO subscription on purpose: it is 要相談 and quoting it here would invent a price.
